user.title: Set up your garden
user.description: Plant Garden adds a garden planner to the sidebar. AI providers and weather sources can be added later.

data_description.garden_name: Shown in the sidebar and on the garden device.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Plant Garden is already set up.

data_description.max_runtime_hours: If an irrigation zone runs longer, a notice appears under Repairs (e.g. a stuck valve).

long_run.title: Irrigation zone {zone} has been running for {hours} h
long_run.description: {entity} has been on for {hours} hours. Check whether the valve is stuck. Plant Garden never switches anything itself. This notice disappears once the zone is off again.

not_loaded.message: Plant Garden is not set up.

not_plant_or_zone.message: {device_id} is neither a plant nor an irrigation zone of Plant Garden.

liters_needed.message: Please give the litres for plants.

minutes_needed.message: Please give the minutes for irrigation zones.

log_watering.name: Log watering
log_watering.description: Records water that Plant Garden did not see itself: litres per plant (watering can) or minutes for a zone (e.g. with the hose).

device_id.name: Plants or zones
device_id.description: Plant Garden devices: plants and/or irrigation zones.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Run time for each selected zone; the amount follows from the zone's precipitation rate.
